AX-P1.name: note_pitch_offset_semitones
AX-P1.unit: semitones (per-note float offset added to ScoreNote.midi)

semantics_disclosure.stage1_duration_predictor: gate_synth.py Stage1 casts note midi to int64 (np.array([ph_midi1], dtype=np.int64) at gate_synth.py:1151,1264,1277) -- fractional offsets are truncated at this stage; NaN raises ValueError('cannot convert float NaN to integer') (observed exit_code=1, HARNESS3C_AXIS_FEASIBILITY_RECORD.md 第1部Step3 pitch_nan)
semantics_disclosure.stage2_pitch_predictor: gate_synth.py Stage2 keeps midi as float32 (np.array([note_midi2], dtype=np.float32) at gate_synth.py:1309,1320) and applies it continuously to the pitch contour -- int and float offsets both render successfully and both differ from baseline
semantics_disclosure.evidence_source: HARNESS3C_AXIS_FEASIBILITY_RECORD.md 第1部 Step1/Step4、第2部 Task1

AX-P1.boundary_behavior: NaN causes a Stage1 ValueError render failure (pitch_nan, exit_code=1); the +-2.0 range boundary values render successfully and byte-deterministically (pitch_minus2 / pitch_offset_minus_2_0, W1+W1b)
AX-P1.grid_coverage: 7 of 9 grid points (-2.0,-1.5,-0.5,0,+0.5,+1.0,+1.5) directly render-verified across W1+W1b; -1.0/+2.0 not directly rendered but covered by the same unconditional linear-addition transform verified at every other grid point (HARNESS3C_AXIS_FEASIBILITY_RECORD.md 第2部 Task1)

AX-D1.name: phrase_duration_redistribution_beats
AX-D1.unit: beats (per-note float delta vector within a phrase, applied to ScoreNote.duration_beats)
AX-D1.transform: duration_beats'_i = duration_beats_i + delta_i for each note i touched within a phrase, subject to sum(delta_i) == 0
AX-D1.sum_constraint: sum(deltas) must equal 0 (beat-level Composition preservation within the touched notes)
AX-D1.quantization_disclosure: gate_synth.py quantizes duration to frames (frame_ms = 1000*hop_size/sample_rate ~= 11.60998ms, gate_synth.py:321-322,1152,1235-1237), independently per note via round() -- the sum of per-note beats is preserved exactly by this axis's sum constraint, but the sum of the resulting rounded frame counts is NOT guaranteed to be preserved. Observed: dur_float_redist (W1, 0.5-beat grid) and both dur_quarter_redist/dur_min_boundary (W1b, 0.25-beat grid) all lost exactly 1 frame (~11.60998ms) of total wav_duration_sec relative to baseline (HARNESS3C_AXIS_FEASIBILITY_RECORD.md 量子化の実測考察 + 第2部 Task2)
AX-D1.boundary_behavior: post-transform duration == 0.25 beat (this axis's min_duration_beats) renders successfully (dur_min_boundary, W1b); duration == 0 beat (below this axis's minimum, W1 dur_zero) does not crash gate_synth either (frames_from_ms clamps to max(...,0)) but is rejected by this axis's own min_duration_beats constraint at the transform layer -- i.e. gate_synth's tolerance is wider than this catalog's declared floor, and the catalog floor is what the transform enforces
